description: AC-11.6 explicit publish approval UI contract. Every publish shows account, content, and visibility and requires operator approval before send.
rules: approved must be the boolean true (operator action); false or missing rejects publish
approved_at must be an ISO-8601 timestamp set at approval time
account.provider_id must match a policy_verified registry provider
content must not include engagement metric fields (AC-11.7)
UI surfaces account, content summary, and visibility before the approve control
notes: OM-035 ships the contract and enforce gate; OM-036 Connected accounts screen uses this shape
Live network publish additionally requires runtime_enabled=true and encrypted tokens (AC-11.5)
